scoring_justification: T1 recompute: plateau velocity extracted from md_velocity_stress.csv and compared to paper gold; v1 recomputed from dispersion curve and compared to paper gold; drag and dispersion scored structurally (low weight).

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for plateau velocity (2.1 nm/ps) and lattice-dynamics limiting velocity v1 (1.56 nm/ps) and wavevector kx (3.28 Å^{-1})
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper reported values: subsonic plateau ~2.1 nm/ps; v1=1.56 nm/ps; kx=3.28 Å^{-1} from dispersion analysis.
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper's results section.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper's headline quantities, traceable to the paper text.

outputs.description: Tabulated steady‑state dislocation velocity versus applied shear stress from MD simulations. The checker derives the subsonic plateau velocity and compares to the paper‑reported value within a tolerance.
Dislocation drag coefficient B estimated from the tangent‑line slope of the velocity‑stress curve. Checker compares to the paper‑derived reference at the selected temperature.

Phonon dispersion curve ω(kx) at fixed ky, kz. The checker performs a structural audit (e.g., verifies existence of a valid branch and checks that the tangent point yields a consistent limiting velocity).

Lattice‑dynamics predicted limiting dislocation velocity v1 and the corresponding tangent wavevector kx, obtained from the dispersion curve via the Celli‑Flytzanis criterion. Checker compares to the paper‑reported value within a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts correspond to the paper's headline quantities: subsonic limiting velocity, drag coefficient, and lattice‑dynamics prediction. The finite‑size scaling analysis (stages 5‑7 of the full paper workflow) is omitted as a supporting check; its essence is captured by the comparison between MD plateau and v1. The proprietary 'vibra' code is replaced by open‑source phonon tools. The transonic velocity regime is excluded per scope.

steps.description: Plateau velocity: mean of velocities for applied stresses >500 MPa compared to paper gold 2.1 nm/ps
Drag coefficient structural: B>0 and temperature in {10,50,100,200} K
Dispersion curve structural: at least 10 points, kx increasing, omega positive
Lattice-dynamics limiting velocity v1 recomputed from dispersion curve and compared to gold 1.56 nm/ps; reported kx checked against paper gold 3.28 Å^{-1}
